description: Resolve a recipient to a full fmsg address without sending anything: a literal @user@domain is returned as-is; this server has no short-name defaults, so other names fail. Fails when nothing matches so you can ask the user for the full address.

name.description: Full fmsg address (@user@domain) or a short name

name: resolve_address

resolution.description: one of "literal", "directory", "default_domain". More values may be added

title: Resolve fmsg address
